subsystem: Deep Fusion Multi-Frame Alignment & Multi-Scale Temporal Fusion (MSTF)

mstf_pipeline_architecture.description: Multi-frame neural alignment and fusion pipeline combining uncompressed multi-exposure short, medium, and long frames into a single synthetic high-dynamic-range, low-noise image.
frame_registration_flow: 1. Pyramid Decomposition: Input frames are recursively downsampled into a 6-level octave pyramid (Scales A through F) via PyrOutProc.
2. Coarse Global Alignment: Coarse scale F (1/32) computes affine/homography global motion transform using feature matching.
3. Multi-Scale Hierarchical Flow: Optical flow estimation proceeds top-down from Scale E (1/16) down to Scale A (1/1).
4. Sub-Pixel Patch Warping: PatchWarper applies coordinate displacement vectors to candidate frames with Q12.4 bicubic interpolation.
5. NCC Matching Verification: NccProc validates warp alignment using Normalized Cross-Correlation, generating confidence maps.
6. Dense Mesh Smoothing: MsFeProc generates continuous displacement vector mesh (MsFeProcMeshDmaSrc).
7. Neural Temporal Blending: MsBeProc fuses Co-Aligned Frames (MsBeProcCAFDmaSrcA..F) using per-pixel neural SNR weighting.

scales.purpose: Full-resolution high-frequency edge restoration and fine detail synthesis
Mid-frequency structural alignment and luma/chroma de-noising
Intermediate flow vector propagation and spatial texture matching
Gross camera shake and rapid object translation compensation
Global affine transformation seed and scene motion boundary detection

patch_warper_engine.patch_block_size: 16x16 pixels with 2-pixel apron / halo boundary (20x20 footprint)

output_metrics.max_loc: Packed 32-bit (X: 16-bit signed, Y: 16-bit signed) displacement vector
output_metrics.out_map: 8-bit normalized correlation coefficient [0..255] representing match confidence

ncc_block_matching_engine.occlusion_rejection: Matches with NCC < 0.65 are tagged as occluded and blended using fallback temporal prior

msbe_neural_fusion.neural_weighting_algorithm: Per-pixel alpha blending where alpha = f(SNR_sensor, NCC_confidence, motion_gradient, luma_variance)
msbe_neural_fusion.ghosting_mitigation: Dual-reference FAR (Fused Aligned Reference) maintains temporal consistency without ghost artifacts
